frame.horizontal: ENU tangent plane at the origin on GRS80 (geodetic -> ECEF -> ENU, evaluated at the origin height); x east, y north; no curvature term
frame.vertical: z = source height - origin.hM, unchanged otherwise; PLATEAU EPSG:6697 heights are orthometric (TP), so z stays a TP height when hM is 0; no geoid or ellipsoid conversion
frame.axis_order: source latitude,longitude,height; station x east, y north, z up; glTF (renderer) x east, y up, z -north
frame.purpose: Station reference frame (docs/core/contract.md Frames) for visual-only context geometry; NOT an envelope processing origin and NOT a routing frame

pois.fields: pois[].category in exit categories; pois[].connectorNodeIds -> graph nodes[].id

window.rule: The window is the union of closed discs in the station frame: R_origin around the origin plus R_exit around every graph node whose kind is in node_rule.exit_kinds (exit connector) or whose floorId is in node_rule.street_floor_ids (street-level node). A feature is selected when its XY bbox meets any disc. With node_rule.exit_poi_connectors, every graph node that pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of a POI whose category is an exit category also gets a disc (an exit whose connector is a stair foot instead of a street node).

selection_rule: A top-level bldg:Building / tran:Road is selected when the XY bounding box of all its polygon vertices (every LOD) in the station frame intersects any closed disc of the window (the union of a disc of R_origin around the frame origin and a disc of R_exit around each exit connector / street-level graph node). Selected features are converted whole; geometry is never cut at the window edge. The window is the union of closed discs in the station frame: R_origin around the origin plus R_exit around every graph node whose kind is in node_rule.exit_kinds (exit connector) or whose floorId is in node_rule.street_floor_ids (street-level node). A feature is selected when its XY bbox meets any disc. With node_rule.exit_poi_connectors, every graph node that pois.json names in connectorNodeIds of a POI whose category is an exit category also gets a disc (an exit whose connector is a stair foot instead of a street node).
lod_policy: Buildings: LOD2 where the building has lod2Solid or a lod2MultiSurface boundary (all inline LOD2 polygons incl. installations), else LOD1; LOD0 is never converted; one LOD per building (a building whose LOD2 solid references do not all resolve to its own inline LOD2 polygons falls back to LOD1, never a mix). Roads: LOD3 only, because LOD1/LOD2 road geometry is flat at z=0; roads without LOD3 height are excluded and counted; no ground height is ever synthesised.
textures: not converted: PLATEAU texture lineage is aerial photography and its licence is unassessed
attribution_text: 出典：国土交通省 Project PLATEAU（3D都市モデル）を加工して作成

mesh_coverage.method: JIS X 0410 3rd-level (8 digit) cells, projected into the station frame, tested against every disc of the window (closed; widened by margin_m)
